name: Aeronautics Museum of Maracay
scope: Public Aeronautics Museum grounds at the former Maracay airfield in September 2021, including the public entrance gate, pavilion and the mapped museum gallery and hangar buildings.

originalReview.notes: The public gate has two ochre posts with broad tapered heads, an ivory lintel carrying the museum name and paired black open gates. Beyond it a straight tiled walk ends at the pale traditional entry hall with a warm hipped roof, three shallow front pediments and dark central doors.

originalReview.notes: Background architecture only. The museum hangar has open bays, dark green steel columns and deep lattice trusses supporting a pale roof. The vehicles and exhibits are excluded.

review.method: Exact local Qualla originals with direct photographer CC0 dedication
review.notes: The exact Qualla originals are marked CC0 by their maker Muago. The west entrance view documents the gate and pavilion; the interior reference is used for its hangar columns and roof trusses only. This scope excludes statues, displays, and separately licensed images.
